description: This file defines a class for creating radar plot areas within a graph rendering utility, including methods for calculating plot dimensions and updating coordinates.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plotarea_Radar
classes.description: A class for creating radar plot areas with methods for dimension calculations and coordinate updates.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Plotarea_Radar
methods.description: Constructor that initializes axes and padding for the radar plot area.

methods.name: _plotWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of the actual plot area excluding padding and axes.

methods.name: _plotHeight
methods.description: Calculates the height of the actual plot area excluding padding and axes.

methods.name: _fillLeft
methods.description: Determines the left boundary of the background fill area.

methods.name: _fillTop
methods.description: Determines the top boundary of the background fill area.

methods.name: _fillRight
methods.description: Determines the right boundary of the background fill area.

methods.name: _fillBottom
methods.description: Determines the bottom boundary of the background fill area.

methods.name: _pointX
methods.description: Calculates the X pixel position for a given data value.

methods.name: _pointY
methods.description: Calculates the Y pixel position for a given data value.

methods.name: _updateCoords
methods.description: Updates the coordinates of axes and plot boundaries based on current element positions.
